newsitem.title: USA: First Central may sell controlling stake.
newsitem.headline: First Central may sell controlling stake.

text.p: First Central Financial Corp on Wednesday said it was negotiating the sale of common stock and warrants to a group of investors led by Connor Clark Ltd that would give them a controlling interest in the company.
The transaction would generate proceeds of at least $14 million, to be used to recapitalize First Central and its wholly owned subsidiary, First Central Insurance Co, the company said in a statement.
First Central, an insurance holding company, expects the deal to close in September.
Connor Clark Ltd is based in Toronto.
